title: viola recorded claude MCP exchange fixture
description: One fixtures/claude/<cli-version>/Mcp.<variant>.json: the frames a live `claude` MCP client sent `viola mcp` through the test-only tap, verbatim and in order up to and including its first `tools/list` request (on protocol 2026-07-28, claude 2.1.302 sends `server/discover` and then `tools/list`, each carrying its own `_meta`), and the result the server answered each request with, keyed by the request's method, scrubbed. Any further key is the CLI's or rmcp's and is allowed (test-plan §7 Fixture hygiene).
